risks: This is a substantial assembly rewrite. ZA tile ownership, predicates, A/B orientation, and output stores must agree; mistakes can corrupt or omit tiles. Repeated transposes may cost more than scratch traffic saved. Include every transpose, allocation, data movement, and SME transition in the timed call.
